system.description:
Elven Seafarers are friends to the wind, and in times of need, they may ask her to treat them kindly.

Obstacle: See Description. Gauge the length of a storm (or other weather), Ob 1. Bring winds to doldrums, Ob 2. Negotiate currents and shoals (+1D Pilot), Ob 3. Speed a long journey (+1D Navigate), Ob 4. Bring a gale down to strong winds, Ob 5.

Actions: 60

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 151
